d:
Mr Bean sees Mr Paliwal practising for a local table tennis tournament and decides he
wants to enter to try to win the cash prize. He goes home, adapts his dining table into a
table tennis table, and designs an ingenious ball-firing machine using a foot pump and
vacuum hose. None of this helps much, and Mr Bean worries he’s not improving – but
could this new device be adapted and answer his problems?
